body: Derive plant crowding inside the habitat registry refresh path, or recompute `PlantGuildState.crowding_index` before every registry rebuild. `compute_habitat_registry()` attenuates habitat light from the cached `crowding_index` field (`crates/tank_core/src/types/habitat.rs:85-94`, `crates/tank_core/src/types/habitat.rs:179`, `crates/tank_core/src/types/habitat.rs:199`, `crates/tank_core/src/types/habitat.rs:215`), but scenario materialization seeds every plant with a placeholder `crowding_index: 0.1` regardless of biomass or tank size (`crates/tank_scenarios/src/lib.rs:783-788`), and trim actions change biomass then immediately refresh the registry without recalculating crowding (`crates/tank_core/src/engine.rs:628-649`, `crates/tank_core/src/engine.rs:727`). That leaves `GlassHardscape`, `PlantSurfaces`, and `SubstrateSurface` light exposure stale after startup and after biomass-changing actions until the next daily plant-growth pass.
